evidence.why: The complete function contains only an unconditional return.
Places the hook between internal exit-callback processing and conditional console cleanup followed by process termination.

facts.rationale: The implementation and caller establish the no-op shutdown role and ordering, but do not establish why no teardown is implemented or whether the platform requires none.
facts.value: Provides the GameCube MSL critical-region shutdown hook as a no-op. When exit reaches this stage, it invokes the hook after internal exit callbacks and before conditional console cleanup and final _ExitProcess; the hook itself simply returns without performing teardown.
